text: DuPont's landmark fermentation process, the first commercialized metabolic engineering product, converts glycerol through 3-HPA into ___, the precursor used to make Sorona fiber.
explanation: This pathway produces 1,3-propanediol (1,3-PDO) via glycerol dehydratase and 1,3-PDO oxidoreductase; DuPont commercialized this process in 2000, marking the first commercial metabolic engineering product, and it is later polymerized into Sorona fiber. The case study underscores that regulatory approval, process scale-up, and cost-competitiveness take years beyond the initial strain engineering.
